info.title: Catholic Tanzania Core API
info.description: Catholic organizational and community directory for Tanzania. Swahili names are primary. Public reads expose active organizations with active primary ancestors, even when a bearer token is supplied. Authorized corrections take effect immediately. Private and administrative operations require an active administrator, permissions, token abilities, and organizational scope. Default limits: public 60/minute/IP; protected 120/minute/user. Tokens expire after eight hours by default. Versioned responses include X-Request-ID. PUT and PATCH are partial updates; DELETE is unavailable. See the consumer guide at /docs on the API origin.

Moves or assigns a parish to a different deanery immediately, preserving history. Requires access to the parish and destination deanery. Effective date cannot be in the future or before the latest transfer. The move is visible immediately when the parish and its new ancestry are active.

Stage 1–500 rows of one public organization type. Supply all required creation fields and existing parent IDs. Omit status and source_id from rows. Strings are trimmed and codes uppercased. Returns 201 even when row validation fails: inspect data.status and data.report.invalid. Does not modify directory records. Identical source/entity/normalized-payload combinations return the existing batch.
Revalidates and atomically upserts by globally unique code. Repeated commits have no effect. Imported active records publish immediately when their ancestry is active.
